easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 21 or higher.
description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Illusions of Grandeur and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Each opponent's Illusions of Grandeur's first ability triggers, and your Illusions of Grandeur's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to gain 20 life and you to lose 20 life.
Cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Each opponent's Illusions of Grandeur's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 20 life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.
